orientation.top_of_map: north (the ring of trees on the far side)
orientation.note_en: Clearing about 8 m across in true units (set built at x9). The round mushroom stands in the centre; the tall buttercup Alice leans on is south-west of it; Alice wanders in through the south gap. Sun from the west-south-west. Camera positions in views[] are described relative to these landmarks.

views.desc_en: eye-level wide shot from the south gap through towering grass stems to the great mushroom under the round open patch of sky
low-angle close shot from the foot of the buttercup up at the rim of the mushroom cap, as if peeping over it on tiptoe
high oblique medium shot from the top of the mushroom cap down to the buttercup and the grass below
eye-level wide shot across the whole clearing into the west-south-west sun, grass and petals backlit, the mushroom in the middle ground
low-angle wide shot from the western trees along the ground through a nave of grass stems toward the daisies
eye-level medium shot from the clover patch past the mushroom stalk to the ox-eye daisies
eye-level close shot from the daisies to the pale mushroom cap edge and its pink-brown gills
eye-level medium shot from the northern trees across the clearing to the buttercup in the sun
low-angle detail shot of the buttercup stem and glowing petals, clover leaves in the foreground

checklist.note_en: ring of trees drawn as sawn-off stumps; mushroom, buttercup, daisies, clover and south gap correct; kept for H2
